Document style
Check your agent's window first. It may have stopped, or it may be waiting on you.
Please take over my live LAHE review. The agent that was working on it stopped answering my comments, and I am asking you to continue it. Run `lahe session list` to find the session for this document, then take it over with: lahe session takeover <session-id> It prints the commands to catch up. Then work every comment that is waiting and reply to each one, and keep watching for new ones.
No unanswered or active threads. Check the done tab, or select some text and press Cmd-Shift-C.

All shortcuts

  • Cmd-Shift-CPress Cmd-Shift-C with nothing selected, then click any element to comment on the whole thing.
  • clickClick the outlined element to comment on it. Esc cancels.
  • Cmd-Shift-EPress Cmd-Shift-E to edit the block you are in. Just that block.
  • Cmd-Shift-EClick + Write here to add text. Esc to finish.
  • Cmd-EnterCmd-Enter when done with this comment.
  • Cmd-Enter, Esc, or a click outsideCmd-Enter, Esc, or click outside to finish the edit and give the page back.
  • EscEsc closes the comment box or cancels picking. Your draft is kept.
  • Cmd-Shift-XPress Cmd-Shift-X to hide the review while you present, and again to bring it back.
  • Cmd-Shift-1Press Cmd-Shift-1 to open or close the review panel.
  • everything elseEverything else is the page. Links, buttons, and forms work exactly as they do without this.

:host([data-lahe-scheme="dark"]) .lahe-sel-cap { background: rgb(15, 18, 22); border-color: rgb(44, 49, 59); color: rgb(233, 235, 240); }
.lahe-done-row .lahe-done-said { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink); white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lahe-thread { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }

.lahe-round-toggle { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; width: 100%; min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 0px; border: 0px; background: none; text-align: left; font: inherit; color: var(--ink-faint); cursor: pointer; }
.lahe-round-chev { flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-flex; align-self: center; color: var(--ink-faint); }
.lahe-round-chev svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; transform: rotate(90deg); transition: transform 120ms; }
.lahe-round-who { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-faint); }
.lahe-round-line { flex: 1 1 0%; min-width: 0px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-faint); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.lahe-thread-turn { margin: 0px; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink-soft); }
.lahe-thread-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.lahe-thread-turn strong { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--ink-faint); }
.lahe-thread-time, .lahe-ask-time { font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.lahe-ask-time { margin-left: auto; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0px; text-transform: none; }
.lahe-followup { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; padding-top: 8px; }
.lahe-followup-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; color: var(--ink-faint); }

.lahe-followup textarea { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 72px; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 9px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: inherit; font-family: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; font-language-override: inherit; line-height: 1.4; }
.lahe-ask { margin: 2px -12px -2px; padding: 10px 12px 11px 13px; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent-wash); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
.lahe-ask .lahe-ask-who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-ink); }
.lahe-ask .lahe-ask-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); flex: 0 0 auto; }
.lahe-ask .lahe-ask-text { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink); overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: pre-wrap; }
:host([data-lahe-scheme="dark"]) .lahe-ask { border-top: 1px solid rgba(147, 167, 234, 0.28); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(147, 167, 234, 0.28); }
.lahe-ask .lahe-ask-fixes { list-style: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.lahe-ask .lahe-fix { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink); overflow-wrap: anywhere; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule,rgba(128,128,128,.25)); padding-top: 6px; }
.lahe-ask .lahe-fix-where { display: block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-faint); }
.lahe-ask .lahe-fix-from { text-decoration: line-through; color: var(--ink-faint); white-space: pre-wrap; }
